channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Nihon Hidankyo hears calls to pass cause to second generation
item.description: About 80 hibakusha survivors of the atomic bombings and other representatives of constituent groups from across Japan attended the meeting in Tokyo.

item.title: Uniqlo on track to overtake H&M, eyes Zara for global No. 1
item.description: The latest results show how far Uniqlo has come from its origins as a low-price Japanese casual-wear chain to become an international brand.

item.title: Japan and cybersecurity: What’s behind recent attacks and what’s being done?
item.description: With artificial intelligence removing hurdles for would-be hackers, experts warn cybersecurity threats are becoming more sophisticated and widespread.

item.title: Nomura and Daiwa CEOs flag risk that AI may spoil stock market rally
item.description: The heads of Japan's two largest securities firms project the Nikkei stock average to reach 80,000 within this year or next.

item.title: Asahi and Kirin among Japan beer giants raided over alleged price-fixing cartel
item.description: Japan's Fair Trade Commission conducted searches of the country's largest beer-makers.

item.title: Japanese city accused of inflating census as country's population shrinks
item.description: As a result, Toyama city may have received more funding from the central government than it should have.

item.title: 'Not again': Arrest of US marine for murder reignites protests in Japan's Okinawa
item.description: For many locals on this island, the arrest has brought decades of frustration back to the fore.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
